$comment: Team-shared Claude Code settings. Personal overrides go in settings.local.json (gitignored). The `hooks` block is the vendor-specific EVENT TRIGGER (CONVENTIONS §7) over a vendor-neutral doer: when a turn ends, the doc reviewer's dry-run runs and prints its one-line report -- deterministic, no model, exit 0 always. Uses the project venv because the doer's agent package needs Python >= 3.10 (the host python3 may be 3.6).
